purpose: Regular update checklist and archive of source URLs used in GrevTakip public data. When a source is used for a public record, keep the exact URL, title, publisher, date, source type, and related data file here.
archive_policy: Prefer source pages with stable article/report URLs over category pages.
For İSİG monthly iş cinayeti data, record the latest updated monthly count as a research target only; do not publish monthly aggregate counts as map records.
For social media or informant leads, keep them as leads until corroborated by union, labor-news, official, or report sources.
When possible, save an external PDF/HTML snapshot outside the repo for long-term archiving; this file records the live URL and metadata.
